name: Spinach
description: Tender green leaves for salads, soups, and quick sautés. Store them loosely and keep excess moisture away.

storage.label: Whole
storage.preparation: Keep unwashed in a perforated bag.
storage.advice: Refrigerate loose leaves promptly without packing them tightly.
storage.caution: For packaged spinach, follow the label and use-by instructions.

buying: Buy pre-cut or bagged greens from a refrigerated display.
freshness: Discard rotten leaves. Follow package dates and any recall notices; freshness checks do not detect every food-safety risk.
leftovers: Stir into a soup just before serving.
Wilt into a pan of beans.

freezing.instructions: Wash and trim. Water-blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool promptly, drain, and pack with ½ inch headspace before freezing.
freezing.quality: Best for cooked dishes rather than a fresh salad.
